english: For each integer $n\ge2$, let $x_{n}$ be the unique positive real number satisfying $x_{n}+x_{n}^{2}+x_{n}^{3}+\dots+x_{n}^{n}=\dfrac{3}{2}$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}x_{n}$ is ______.
hindi: प्रत्येक पूर्णांक $n\ge2$ के लिए माना कि $x_{n}$ वह अद्वितीय धनात्मक वास्तविक संख्या है जो $x_{n}+x_{n}^{2}+x_{n}^{3}+\dots+x_{n}^{n}=\dfrac{3}{2}$ को संतुष्ट करती है। तब $\displaystyle\lim_{n\to\infty}x_{n}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: LHS is increasing in $x>0$ and equals $n\ge2$ at $x=1$, so $0<x_{n}<1$. GP sum: $\dfrac{x_{n}(1-x_{n}^{n})}{1-x_{n}}=\dfrac32\Rightarrow5x_{n}-3=2x_{n}^{n+1}$
solution_full: Let $S_{n}(x)=x+x^{2}+\dots+x^{n}$. It is strictly increasing for $x>0$, with $S_{n}(0)=0$ and $S_{n}(1)=n\ge2>\dfrac32$, so the root $x_{n}$ exists, is unique and lies in $(0,1)$.
For $0<x<1$, $S_{n}(x)=\dfrac{x(1-x^{n})}{1-x}$. Setting this equal to $\dfrac32$: $2x-2x^{n+1}=3-3x$, i.e. $x_{n}=\dfrac{3}{5}+\dfrac{2}{5}x_{n}^{\,n+1}$.
Bound: since $S_{n}(x)\ge x+x^{2}$, we get $x_{n}+x_{n}^{2}\le\dfrac32$, so $x_{n}\le x_{2}$, where $x_{2}^{2}+x_{2}-\dfrac32=0$ gives $x_{2}=\dfrac{-1+\sqrt7}{2}\approx0.82$.
Hence $0<x_{n}^{\,n+1}\le x_{2}^{\,n+1}\to0$ as $n\to\infty$ (a fixed base less than $1$).
(Treating the equation as the infinite series $\dfrac{x}{1-x}=\dfrac32$ gives the right value, but the uniform bound $x_{n}\le x_{2}<1$ is what justifies $x_{n}^{\,n+1}\to0$.)
originality_note: New: a sequence defined only implicitly as roots of finite geometric equations; the limit needs the closed form plus a uniform bound x_n <= x_2 < 1 to kill x_n^{n+1} (way 1/way 5). Closest known: the analysis exercise x + x^2 + ... + x^n = 1 with limit 1/2. Different because: the right side 3/2 makes x_n move from about 0.82 down to 0.6, and the bound must come from the n = 2 equation.

concept_use.Miscellaneous concepts on Limit: The limit of an implicitly defined sequence of roots, via the closed form 5x_n - 3 = 2x_n^{n+1} and the bound x_n <= x_2 < 1.
